summary: Full end-to-end validation of the NISM-style Mock Exam feature after user manually applied migrations. 14/14 backend pytest tests PASS covering admin auto-create/PATCH exam, CSV bulk import (with per-row error handling for missing question and <2 options), single-question CRUD, admin questions list, student GET exam (correct_answer_index correctly hidden), student start attempt, student submit-with-all-correct-scores-100%-and-passed=true, security (student→403 on admin routes; foreign attempt_id→403; unauthenticated→401/403). Admin UI verified: Module 16 is the ONLY module with an 'EXAM MODULE' badge, MockExamModal opens with correct title 'NISM Series XV — Research Analyst Certification', Import CSV button + panel + textarea work, 3 questions inserted via CSV are listed with topic tags and difficulty chips. Student dashboard loads without error. Mock Exam CTA is NOT shown for testagent2026 because their active enrollment (Equity Research Analyst path, id ab43a64a-70bc-473f-b533-fb958267a739) has NO user_modules row for Module 16 (5a6dd7bb-…) — this is a data/enrollment condition, NOT a bug in the feature. Submit endpoint handled the missing user_module gracefully (200, score=100, passed=true, no crash).

minor.issue: When student passes but has no matching user_modules row for the exam module in their active enrollment, the module-complete flip is silently skipped (correctly caught & logged). Not a bug — expected behavior per code; just worth surfacing to admin/UI so student is not confused.

integration_issues.issue: testagent2026 does not have Module 16 in user_modules for their active enrollment, so the 'Take Mock Exam' CTA never appears on their dashboard. Not a code bug — enrollment data condition. Main agent should decide whether to (a) seed M16 into a test user's user_modules to E2E the CTA, or (b) allow students to attempt any exam module even if not enrolled.

critical_code_review_comments: wave_endpoints.py line ~2683: admin_mock_exam_question_create ORs `correct_answer_index or 0` — this collapses a legitimate 0 (first option correct) into the default 0 as well, but that's harmless. However if index is negative or >= len(options) it is NOT validated on create (only defensively coerced in CSV import). Add same guard here.

wave_endpoints.py line ~2890: score computed as (correct/total*100) — pass_percentage cast via float(exam['pass_percentage']). Good. Consider persisting exam_id in the attempt so a stale attempt whose exam was modified doesn't drift.
MockExamModal shows 'Score to pass: 2 / 3' — computed from pass_percentage. Correct.
Backend submit endpoint returns the correct_answer_index in review[] as intended (review after submission). Good separation from student GET.
user_mock_exam_attempts table has `started_at`/`completed_at` but NO `created_at`. Ordering elsewhere may assume created_at — safe here because backend orders by nothing; just noting.
